verdict.rationale: Bulk export of traces or datasets to blob storage or a data warehouse is a fair question for an observability platform like Sentry, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents such an export: the docs cover viewing traces, AI spans and dashboards in the UI, and the CLI probe never mentions exporting data. Viewing traces in Explore or self-hosting are not the export capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-export traces and datasets to blob storage or my data warehouse
